facts.fact: Assabah reports that the national cybersecurity agency (الوكالة الوطنية للسلامة السيبرنية) issued a statement on 30 July 2026, so the agency exists and operates.
The national cybersecurity agency issued a public warning on 30 July 2026 about an SMS phishing campaign using fake traffic-fine notices from foreign numbers to harvest banking data.
